new_result.name: QFORM-ZEROPIVOT-RECTANGULAR-v1
new_result.statement: For disjoint I,J,K with |I|=m>=2, A[I,I]=0 and B=A[I,J] full row rank, ||p_{X^TAX}||_infinity <= (m/(m-1))*sqrt(2)*det(BB^T)^(-1/(2m)); in particular m=2 costs 2sqrt(2)*det(BB^T)^(-1/4).
new_result.scope_limit: Exact zero pivot is essential; arbitrary pivot-side curvature at cross rank two is not covered.

target_family: For even N, B_N has two orthonormal diffuse rows and all 2x2 local minors 0 or 2/N; [[0,B_N],[B_N^T,0]] has eigenvalues +1,+1,-1,-1 and universal density bound 2sqrt(2) by the new theorem.
unresolved_implication: QFORM-CURVATURE-OR-AGGREGATE-PIVOT-v2: derive from only the three-large-eigenvalue spectral hypothesis a dimension-free original-coordinate branch paid by controlled local curvature, aggregate zero-pivot Gram volume, rank>2 full singular-value product, or a diffuse product-preserving remainder mechanism.
next_step: Use A^2/spectral-projector identities to prove a curvature-versus-aggregate cross-Gram dichotomy before selecting local minors; route the curvature side into existing pair/triple theorems.
